feed.title: OpenWalkieTalkie Blog
feed.subtitle: Build logs and write-ups from the open-source handheld radio for your AI agents.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.11.0: Conol and native companions
entry.summary: Conol conversations, new-chat dictation and multi-step questions on the deck, with an open companion API for other apps.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.10.0: Computer resources on the deck
entry.summary: A live CPU, memory, GPU and storage page for your Mac, more efficient Flappy Bird rendering, and longer original Arcade music.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.9.0: Clearer USB speech and reset reminders
entry.summary: 48 kHz USB speaker playback, improved 16 kHz audio, and reminders before unused manual usage resets expire on your Mac and deck.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.8.0: Screen lock and consistent wheel navigation
entry.summary: An automatic screen lock protects PTT in your bag, with four counterclockwise ticks to unlock and a consistent direction for page and item selection.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.7.0: Clearer speech, less hiss
entry.summary: Speaker EQ for speech and chimes, plus RAM execution on Rev A to reduce flash-coupled hiss while keeping settings and Bluetooth pairing intact.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.6.0: Arcade on the deck
entry.summary: Three full-screen games, physical controls, and original 8-bit music and effects with an Off switch.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.5.0: Desktop connected, factory ready
entry.summary: Codex Desktop connection fixes, reliable short replies, alternate flash support, and factory programming images.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.4.0: recovery on screen, room to grow
entry.summary: A guided bootloader upgrade, recovery progress on the deck, faster USB transfers, and Chinese text.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.3.0: images and pending questions
entry.summary: Chat images on your Mac and deck, stable image previews, and Codex questions you can answer from the handheld.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.2.1: our radio, everywhere
entry.summary: The website radio comes to the app icon, menu bar, device splash and About screen. A COHDL project.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.2.0: workflows at a glance
entry.summary: Live workflow progress on your Mac and handheld, Claude Fable usage limits, and a fix for the blinking workflow page.

entry.title: OpenWalkieTalkie v0.1.0: a handheld for your agents
entry.summary: The first official Mac app and firmware release: push-to-talk, conversations on the deck, and app and device updates.
